summary: REQ-10 is partially addressed by wrapping the RouterProvider in AuthProvider inside frontend/src/App.tsx, which should prevent useAuth() being called outside the provider. However, the updated RootComponent used as the TanStack Router root route does not render an outlet/child routes, which likely breaks the existing authenticated routing behavior (pages/routes may never render), putting the acceptance criterion about preserving authentication-gated routing behavior at risk.

missing_requirements.requirement: Authentication-gated routing behavior remains intact (unauthenticated users see the Login page; authenticated users see the AppLayout) while still allowing routed pages (e.g., PostsListPage, PostDetailPage, etc.) to render under the router root.
missing_requirements.reason: RootComponent (used as createRootRoute({ component: RootComponent })) returns <LoginPage /> or <AppLayout /> but never renders an outlet/child route content. With TanStack Router, the root route component typically needs to render an <Outlet /> (often inside AppLayout) for child routes to appear; without it, the defined child routes (/, /post/$postIndex, etc.) may not render at all, altering routing behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an initialization/loading spinner screen with "Loading..." when isInitializing is true.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-10 only requests fixing the AuthProvider/useAuth runtime error and preserving gated routing; a dedicated loading UI was not requested.
